title: Book One · Chapter 148: Not This Story
story:
Ronan asks Dad after breakfast one quiet morning. Dad has not left for work yet. There is time to sit with him. Mum has gone to get cloth. The yard is quiet except for Mr Qiu opening his boxes.

“I wrote something,” Ronan says. “It is not at school.”

He gives Dad the folded card. Dad opens it on the table. Ronan watches his eyes move down the short lines. They stop before the end.

“No,” Dad says.

Ronan waits. Dad puts the card down carefully, but his hand stays on it.

“Not this story.”

“It says you can still do things.”

Dad looks up. “I could do things before.”

“I know.”

“Then why do you begin with my old shop? I closed it.”

Ronan cannot answer quickly. He wanted a story with a change. He wanted to show Dad's work since the move. He did not mean that Dad was no good before. He looks at the start of his card again.

“I thought it would make people understand.”

“Understand what?”

“Us.”

Dad rubs his thumb along the fold. “People can visit your display. Our private stories can stay private.”

Ronan looks down at the little drawing of the old window. The tree is there. The red bike is there. He has not written about the bike. But the drawing makes him think of the day it left. He looks back at Dad.

“Are you angry?”

“A little. And I am telling you now, before it goes anywhere.”

Ronan nods. Dad takes his hand off the card. He is not taking it away or tearing it. “What should I do with it now?” Ronan wants to ask. But Dad leaves the card on the table. Ronan must make his own choice about the card.

“I will not use it,” he says.

“Thank you.”

There is a long silence. Mr Qiu says good morning to someone outside. A spoon falls in a neighbour's kitchen.

“Can the tree come?” Ronan asks at last.

Dad looks at the drawing again. “Keep the old-home picture for yourself this time.”

Ronan folds the card. He puts it with the old picture between the boards. Neither is on the display list now. He wanted to show both at school. Now he must leave them at home. He adds nothing else. He puts his list down.

Dad sees his face. He reaches for him, then stops short of a hand on his head.

“Do you still want me there?”

Ronan looks up at once. “Yes.”

“Even without this?”

“Yes.”

Dad nods slowly. He must go out soon. The question about work hours is still unanswered. He still does not know his work hours. He cannot promise to come just to make Ronan feel better.

Dad brings a low stool outside. He has a little time before work. Ronan holds the door for him. One leg is loose. The stool belongs to their kitchen. It still needs a repair.

“You can sit near me if you want,” Dad says. “I will look at this first.”

Dad turns the stool upside down on an old cloth. He shows Ronan the gap near the leg. Ronan leans closer. Now he can see the gap. “Will a nail fix it?” he asks. Dad says he needs to look at the joint first. Dad asks for a clean rag. Ronan brings it. He does not reach into the blue box for a tool.

Ronan brings a chair. The folded card stays inside. For the next half hour, Dad looks at the stool. Ronan sits near him and holds the rag. They do not write anything for the display.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：not this＝不要这一个；fold＝折痕、折叠；loose leg＝松动的凳腿。

情节提示：joint＝木头接合处；rag＝抹布；stool＝凳子。

理解：1. Dad 为什么拒绝展出这张故事卡？2. 这次拒绝有没有改变 Ronan 对 Dad 本人的邀请？
